subject: general
question: As of 10 April 2022, which state has the maximum number of members in the Rajya Sabha?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Uttar Pradesh__**

**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Uttar Pradesh has **31 members** in the Rajya Sabha.
 
• **Rajya Sabha**:-
 
 
• The actual strength of the Rajya Sabha is **245** of which **233 are elected** and **12 are nominated**. 
 
• Members of the Rajya Sabha are elected by the members of the** Assemblies of States and Union Territories** in accordance with the **system of proportional representation** by means of the **single transferable vote**. 
 
• **Fourth Schedule** to the constitution provides for the allocation of seats.
 
• The term of a member is **6 years**, but a member elected in a bye-election serves for the remainder of the term of the vacancy caused.
 
• Rajya Sabha is called a **permanent body** as it is not subject to dissolution which means **one-third of its members retire every second year**.
